rules.rule:
#### Homey Tuya Zigbee — driver sacred couple
- Never invent productId / modelId; identity is manufacturerName + productId only.
- Settings keys: zb_manufacturer_name + zb_model_id (never camelCase zb_modelId).
- Capability updates MUST go through safeSetCapabilityValue (L14).
- Virtual buttons: never raw setCapabilityValue('button'); use safe path / markAppCommand.
- Batteries: ban linear (V-2.5)/0.5; use SmartBatteryManager / non-linear profiles.
- Mains devices: get mainsPowered() { return true; } and never phantom measure_battery.
- Backlight settings are strings off|normal|inverted only.
- EF00 brightness MCU 0–1000 via TuyaBrightnessScale — never write >1000.
- Timers: use lib/utils/safe-timers (safeSetTimeout/Interval); clear on onDeleted/onUninit.
- Flow cards: getDeviceTriggerCard(id) one arg only (SDK3); declare⇒wire for scene_recall/set_brightness/rotate.
- Contre quoi: every behavior fix needs test/critical/pNNNN-*.test.js.

#### Homey runtime lib
- Prefer Buffer JSON.parse for large DB loads (heap OOM on Homey Pro 64MB).
- IntelligentProtocolDetect: never force EF00 TX on sacred zcl_only BSEED couples.
- IAS sleepy: enroll on wake; skip leftover EF00 TX (shouldSkipIasOnlyEf00Tx).
- Dual-app: classify BOTH|MASTER_ONLY|STABLE_ONLY before feature vs reliability.
- Null-safe cluster access; no ==/!=; no eval/Function string timers.
- Intervals/timeouts must be clearable; check _destroyed before device I/O.

#### GHA Homey project
- Top-level permissions + concurrency + defaults.run.shell=bash + timeout-minutes.
- Node jobs: checkout → setup-node → npm ci.
- No secret echo; guard missing secrets; continue-on-error for optional secrets.
- Never pull_request_target untrusted checkout without hardening.
- AI forfait: AI_FORCE_LOCAL=true, AI_ALLOW_REMOTE=false unless explicitly paid.
- Forum: SHADOW only — never auto POST to Homey Community.

#### CI tools
- Silent enrich only; never invent mfr+pid.
- Complementary variant enrich (P2520): union/append, never wipe compose.
- Report-only semantic linters must not auto-modify driver sources.
